tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind the app shell and main content.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the sidebar, dialogs, inputs and table bodies.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Hover fill for quiet controls, table header row, neutral badge fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card and table edges, dividers. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons. Meets 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg, surface and surface-muted.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions, table headers, timestamps. At least 6:1 on bg, surface and surface-muted in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Friday purple. Primary buttons, links, the selected nav item, focus rings. As text it meets 6:1 on surface and accent-subtle.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills and links.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Never put text on accent in any other colour.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Tint for the selected nav item, info banners and the empty-state icon disc.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy connection, successful sync. Text and icons on ok-bg or surface.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind ok badges and banners.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention: reconnect required, sync delayed. Text on warning-bg or surface.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning badges and banners.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Failed sync, invalid input, destructive actions. Text on error-bg or surface.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind error badges and banners, and the danger button's hover.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs.

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Sign-in and onboarding headlines only. Once per page.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and dialog titles, section headings.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Friday Hub syncs your calendar every 15 minutes.
styles.usage: Default text, inputs, descriptions under page titles.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, emphasis inside body text.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Table cells, field descriptions, card descriptions.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Status badges and other compact labels.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: API tokens, scopes, IDs and request examples.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to input; icon to its text in a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a group; icon to label in a button.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input side padding; banner and table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields and between cards in a grid; table cell side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and dialog padding; gap under the page header.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Main content padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding; space between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes and small inline chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, banners, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, dialogs, empty states.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status badges and the spinner.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Optional lift for a card that is being dragged or highlighted. Cards are flat by default.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Dialogs and toasts: anything floating above the page.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons inside table rows.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: App shell sidebar on screens wider than 720px.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the main content column.
